acceptance.given: A repository-contained supported Toolchain Skill target has been requested for inspection.

oracle.expected: An independent execution witness binds observed opened/read target paths to the requested target identity and the resulting receipt.
forbidden: Accepting a target manifest or declared path without an observed effective read.
Relying on an inspection result whose observed target differs from the intended target.
oracle.observable: The instrumented target-read witness and its identity binding in the Toolchain inspection receipt.

acceptance.then: Effective inspection of the intended target is independently verified before the result is accepted or relied upon.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain evaluates an inspection result before acceptance or reliance.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Use an instrumented inspection that reads a different target or emits no read witness and require acceptance to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind an independent observed-read witness to the requested target identity and reject inspection receipts without a matching effective-read observation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Receipt enrichment is additive; mismatched or absent effective-read witnesses fail closed.

slice_hint.state_transition: Requested target without independent effective-inspection proof -> requested target with a matching observed-read witness bound to its receipt.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No inspection result is accepted unless an independent observed-read witness establishes that the intended target was effectively inspected.

acceptance.given: An external process or aggregate reaches its configured time or output budget limit.

oracle.expected: The bounded execution reaches a deterministic unsuccessful terminal result.
forbidden: Budget exhaustion is classified as successful.
Budget exhaustion is treated as an indeterminate success or omitted outcome.
oracle.observable: A real budget-exhaustion execution is evaluated through the external-process and aggregate terminal-state path.

acceptance.then: The budget-exhausted execution has an unsuccessful terminal result.
acceptance.when: A configured execution budget is exhausted.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the authored S11 behavior selector with a process or aggregate that exhausts its configured time or output budget and observe the unsuccessful terminal outcome.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Classify a time- or output-budget-exhausted external process or aggregate as a deterministic unsuccessful terminal result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore only Toolchain execution-result handling; no Phase service state or schema changes are permitted.

slice_hint.state_transition: An external process or aggregate reaches a time or output budget limit -> The budget-exhausted execution has an unsuccessful terminal result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A budget-exhaustion run terminates deterministically as unsuccessful and is never published as successful, indeterminate success, or omitted.

acceptance.given: An applicable Consumer has a bound rollback fixture and a captured Prior Route identity with its verdict and diagnostic baseline.

oracle.expected: The receipt proves the Consumer invoked the Prior Route through its real call surface and observed the same Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.
forbidden: A rollback without a real Consumer call.
A changed Prior Route identity, verdict, or diagnostic category.
oracle.observable: The Consumer rollback receipt and route-call trace for each applicable fixture.

acceptance.then: Behavioral rollback is executed through the real Consumer call surface and restores the Prior Behavior Baseline.
acceptance.when: The rollback transition is exercised through the repository replay toolchain.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise an applicable Consumer rollback fixture whose Prior Route call is omitted, simulated, or replaced by configuration-only switching.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record and verify real Consumer invocation of the Prior Route during behavioral rollback, including restored route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback receipts remain additive and must preserve the existing Prior Route identity and baseline semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: applicable rollback fixture with captured Prior Route baseline -> real Prior Route Consumer invocation -> restored Prior Behavior Baseline receipt
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Each applicable Consumer has a real-call rollback receipt whose route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category equal its captured Prior Behavior Baseline.

acceptance.given: A pinned semantic result has bound diagnostic categories and a fresh checkout has the pinned replay inputs available.

oracle.expected: Fresh replay evidence contains diagnostic categories equal to the pinned semantic result categories.
forbidden: A semantic reproduction claim with different diagnostic categories.
Diagnostic categories inferred from labels or prose.
Replay evidence produced before reconstruction of the pinned inputs.
oracle.observable: Machine-verifiable pinned and fresh replay diagnostic-category fields and their equality comparison.

acceptance.then: The fresh replay establishes equality of the pinned and replayed diagnostic categories.
acceptance.when: The toolchain reconstructs pinned inputs and produces fresh replay diagnostic output.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Replay a pinned semantic result with a diagnostic-category mismatch and require semantic reproduction to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Rebuild the pinned input identities before fresh replay and compare machine-verifiable fresh diagnostic categories with the pinned semantic result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Replay evidence remains non-authorizing and preserves existing terminal-category compatibility while adding no inferred diagnostic equivalence.

slice_hint.state_transition: pinned diagnostic categories without fresh equality proof -> reconstructed pinned identities -> fresh replay -> machine-verified diagnostic-category equality or failed reproduction
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A fresh replay, after reconstructing the pinned identities, has machine-verifiable diagnostic categories exactly equal to the pinned semantic result.
